Medium.solution:
**Identify.** A full wave rectifier circuit consists of two p-n junction diodes, a centre-tapped transformer, capacitor and a load resistance. Which of these components remove the ac ripple from the rectified output?

**Concept.** After rectification, a shunt capacitor filter smooths the output by charging/discharging — it removes the AC ripple.

**Work.** Diodes rectify; centre-tap transformer supplies opposite phases; load dissipates power but does not filter ripple.

✗ (3) Load resistance — Load resistance dissipates power; it is not the filter.
✗ (4) A centre-tapped transformer — Centre-tapped transformer provides the two half-cycles.
